notes.title: Update! Patch notes: Your Seeds Are Safe Now

[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the resource colors would reset after closing and reopening the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where prices were incorrectly calculated when purchasing 10 or 50 items at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where house objects wouldn't appear until the house tab was clicked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused special mushrooms and flowers to spawn increasingly more frequently over time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added seed cost display to the tooltip when hovering over house upgrade buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the seed value earned per click to the UI.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you like what we're doing or you are curious about our future, slap that wishlist button, it helps more than you think. notes.title: The Idle Garden Demo Has Sprouted!
notes.notes:
[p]You ever planted a seed, forgot about it, and then come back to a whole ecosystem?
That’s the vibe. But not this game.[/p][p]Our [b]first demo[/b] is live, and it’s all about seeds, Clics, and letting nature do its thing (while you do absolutely nothing).[/p][p]
[/p][h3]In this idle game, you’ll:
[/h3][list][*][p]Plant seeds that grow even when you're AFK
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Watch a mysterious [b]Garden[/b] evolve [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Uncover secrets (or not, we won’t force you)
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Maybe meet a [b]spirit[/b] who’s into gardening and passive progress[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]It’s a garden. It’s a game. It’s an experiment in chill.
And yes, the numbers go up.[/p][p]This is our first public build, so your feedback is everything.
Tell us if the balance feels off. Tell us if the tree looks weird.
Tell us if you somehow broke the spirit (please don’t).

Try it now! or leave us in the wishlist:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709800/Idle_Tree_Keeper_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
